title: R_4(4(x-y)=3z) = 313
statement: The 4-colour Rado number of the equation 4(x-y) = 3z is exactly 313: every 4-colouring of {1,...,313} contains a monochromatic solution, and some 4-colouring of {1,...,312} avoids one. This value lies outside the published four-colour table, whose coprime coverage extends only to a+b <= 6.

prior_art.citation: Y. Chang, J. A. De Loera, W. J. Wesley, 'Rado Numbers and SAT Computations', ISSAC 2022
prior_art.establishes: R_3(a(x-y)=(a-1)z) = a^3 + (a-1)^2 for a >= 3, and a four-colour table covering only a+b <= 6. This entry is absent from it.

evidence.supports: identifies F_313, the formula every verdict below is about
evidence.notes: 1252 variables, 63812 clauses, 1644446 bytes. Until 2026-08-13 this row did not exist: five cover ledgers recorded 'unsat' verdicts and NOTHING in the claim identified which formula they were verdicts about. The pin is checked by regeneration, not by hash alone -- check-claim-certificates.py re-derives the CNF from (a,b,k,n)=(4,3,4,313) with an encoder written independently of scripts/gen-rado-instance.py and requires byte-identity, so a bug shared by one implementation cannot authenticate itself. Both encoders agree on this sha256.

Verified three independent ways: axeyum's own model self-check (formula.evaluate on the lifted model), a purpose-written brute-force checker sharing no code or gcd reduction with the generator, and the ledger checker. 15,093 solutions enumerated in [312]^2, none monochromatic.

1024/1024 cells refuted by the axeyum proof-producing CDCL core; 800 per-cell DRAT proofs accepted by the in-tree check_drat, 224 deferred past the check cap. Reproduced independently on two hosts with different worker counts, both reporting 80,975,667 derived clauses -- bit-identical, as the determinism contract requires. The residual 'checked refutations of an exhaustive cover imply UNSAT' step is a meta-argument, not a checked DRAT derivation.

A structurally DIFFERENT exhaustive decomposition of the same instance (branch integers 2,3,4,5,6 rather than 2,4,6,8,10), reaching the same verdict with a higher checked fraction. Two covers that partition the search space differently and agree is stronger evidence than one cover alone.
Third exhaustive decomposition, branching on odd integers only. Fewer proofs checked, but it exercises a disjoint branch set.

evidence.supports: R_4 <= 313 (upper bound, complete cover with all proofs retained)
evidence.checker_command: BRANCH=2,4,6,8,10,12 certify_cover r_d313.cnf d313.tsv proofs_d313 4 14   # axeyum check_drat_backward
evidence.notes: Complete exhaustive cover of [1..4]^6, produced and CERTIFIED entirely by axeyum. Search: 4096/4096 cells refuted in 164.5 s on 14 workers with all proofs retained (9.0 GiB). Certification: all 4096 per-cell DRAT proofs verified by axeyum's in-tree backward checker in 268.4 s -- 149,439,877 proof steps, zero failures, zero missing. Each cell's augmented formula is rebuilt from the recorded colour tuple, not taken from the proof. The artifact is the CERTIFICATION ledger emitted by that pass -- one row per cell recording the backward checker's verdict -- not the search ledger. Conflating the two was caught by the validator: the search ran with inline checking disabled, so its own ledger records every cell as deferred.

notes: Second exact value determined in this work. Its excess over a^4 is 57, which refutes all three natural liftings of the proven three-colour law a^3 + (a-1)^2: a^4 + (a-1)^2 = 265, a^4 + (a-1)^3 = 283, and a^4 + (a-1)^4 = 337. No closed form reproducing 57 is known to us. Monolithic CDCL did not finish n = 316, 320 or 325 within 36 minutes each, while cube-and-conquer settled n = 313 in 8.5 minutes. HARDENING: F_313 was refuted by FOUR exhaustive covers across three distinct branch sets and two hosts, with zero check_drat failures anywhere and bit-identical derived-clause counts (80,975,667) between two of them. An independent re-derivation of the formula found zero clauses lacking a problem justification, and small values of the family were reproduced with symmetry breaking disabled entirely. Full per-cube checking of all 224 non-trivial cells is a ~300 core-hour job at the forward checker's current speed -- a throughput limit, not a soundness one. A restarted run that appended to a live status file was caught by the cover checker (1093 rows, 69 duplicates) and quarantined unused.
